detailed_descriptions.en: A Game About Opening A Chest is as literal as the name implies. The greedy King demands a hefty tax - but you’ve got a plan to get him all the gold he could ever dream of! Deep below a perilous dungeon, is a grand Chest of infinite loot. Every time the Chest is opened a new piece of loot is added to your inventory. Strategically swap loot upon the Altars for powerful synergies to quickly amass gold, while mitigating any threats that may try to snatch your riches away! This incremental roguelike includes 3 separate levels , each offering unique mechanics and challenges to overcome. There is an ever-rising goal to meet, and you’ll need to experiment with different loot combinations to ensure you don’t come up short. Synergy crafting, NPC bonuses, realm threats and other build-testing events vary between each Level. Opening more Chests is always the answer ! Chest Dungeon – Find the best combo and maximize your gold output Astral Void – Manage your growing Madness before it consumes you King’s Hall – Upgrade, socket and temper your loot for insane bonuses Master every level to access a Pause-free Hard Mode to put your looting skills to the test! A never-ending supply of loot! Swords, Shields, Rings and… Guns?! Procedural stats mean each new piece has a chance to be build-defining! Scale through 6 tiers of loot rarity from Common to Infernal, all in the blink of a Chest Make trade-offs between gold generation, stat boosting, or protection from threats Place loot upon the Altars to activate their abilities Strategically place Type and Class combinations for massive Multipliers Hot-swap your loot in a constant pursuit of a more powerful synergy Stack bonuses, break the limits, and watch the gold overflow AND GOLD, LOTS OF GOLD ! Never forget that. Everything else is just a means to an end.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A Game About Opening A Chest is as literal as the name implies. The greedy King demands a hefty tax - but you’ve got a plan to get him all the gold he could ever dream of! Deep below a perilous dungeon, is a grand Chest of infinite loot. Every time the Chest is opened a new piece of loot is added to your inventory. Strategically swap loot upon the Altars for powerful synergies to quickly amass gold, while mitigating any threats that may try to snatch your riches away!

This incremental roguelike includes 3 separate levels, each offering unique mechanics and challenges to overcome. There is an ever-rising goal to meet, and you’ll need to experiment with different loot combinations to ensure you don’t come up short. Synergy crafting, NPC bonuses, realm threats and other build-testing events vary between each Level. Opening more Chests is always the answer!

  • Chest Dungeon – Find the best combo and maximize your gold output

  • Astral Void – Manage your growing Madness before it consumes you

  • King’s Hall – Upgrade, socket and temper your loot for insane bonuses

Master every level to access a Pause-free Hard Mode to put your looting skills to the test!

  • A never-ending supply of loot! Swords, Shields, Rings and… Guns?!

  • Procedural stats mean each new piece has a chance to be build-defining!

  • Scale through 6 tiers of loot rarity from Common to Infernal, all in the blink of a Chest

  • Make trade-offs between gold generation, stat boosting, or protection from threats

  • Place loot upon the Altars to activate their abilities

  • Strategically place Type and Class combinations for massive Multipliers

  • Hot-swap your loot in a constant pursuit of a more powerful synergy

  • Stack bonuses, break the limits, and watch the gold overflow

AND GOLD, LOTS OF GOLD! Never forget that. Everything else is just a means to an end.
